title: How Robust Is Rhyme Planning to Prompt Perturbation? Testing Whether Planning Features Are Sensitive to Input Framing

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if planning features are fragile under prompt variation, then safety conclusions drawn from them are unreliable. This directly informs how much we can trust interpretability findings for safety-critical assessments.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: TransformerLens probing is well-documented in ARENA. Creating a battery of poetry prompt variants is straightforward. The probing methodology is already established from the baseline paper. Medium compute is sufficient for a 7B model.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single focused experiment: create prompt variants, run probing classifiers, compute robustness correlation. Clear deliverable (robustness score plot). Well-bounded in 30 hours with a fixed set of prompts.
